'''Marissa''' is a female NPC who appears in [[Ragunna]], [[Rinascita]]. She can be seen talking to [[Giovanna]] and [[Sandra]] from 6:00 AM to 5:59 PM.

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Giovanna:''' Isn't the Carnevale coming up soon? I just passed by Gondola Market and saw lots of exotic flowers and decorations there.
:'''Sandra:''' I'm going to decorate our windowsill nicely for the festival this time.
:'''Marissa:''' I heard that this year's Carnevale is being organized entirely by the Montellis.
:'''Giovanna:''' No wonder there are so many imports in the market. The Montelli family has money to spare and trade routes everywhere. Only they could pull off such a huge event.
:'''Sandra:''' My little Pietro just started at Averardo, and after only two days, he came home saying that the [[Montelli Family|Montelli family]] had a hand in all of Ragunna's trade, both imports and exports.
:'''Marissa:''' Pietro really knows it all! He's so lucky to have a perfect job. Shame that his childhood friend, Gavino, hasn't been as fortunate.
:'''Sandra:''' What happened to Gavino?
:'''Marissa:''' Did you know he joined an underground troupe some time ago? He got arrested by the Order Penitentiary recently, so he might be heading to the Pilgrim's Sail soon.
:'''Giovanna:''' Poor boy... I hope he can clear his name and return repented.
:'''Marissa:''' Sentinel's grace, Giovanna! Please don't say that. Gavino is a good child, and there is no sin in him.
----
;(After {{Quest|Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides}}
:{{Spoiler}}
:'''Marissa:''' Gavino made it back home safe and sound... what a relief.
:'''Giovanna:''' He's a lucky one. Granted absolution before stepping aboard the Sail.
:'''Marissa:''' I wonder if the Pilgrim's Sail will soon be a thing of the past... Hopefully, history won't repeat itself.
{{Dialogue End}}
